notes: Computer panel: a Chat tab beside Controls, with that PC's conversation and its unread count, so you can message a PC without going to the Chat page. Power on: an off computer's panel can switch it on over the network (Wake-on-LAN must be on in its BIOS); the counter learns each PC's network card while it is on. Pay stations: a new switch lets customers pay for a PC that is off, which the counter then switches on and gives the time once it starts (off by default; a PC that does not come on within five minutes shows as failed). Fix: a reply sent from the counter no longer shows twice in the chat. Goes with client 1.64.0.
